paite: Huchi in Jerubbaal, huai tuh Gideon ahi a, huan akiang a om mi tengteng zingkhang in athou ua, Harod tuikhuk chin ah akikulh uh. Midiante bel mallam pang Moreh mual bul phaizang ah akikulh uhi.
heading: Gideon In Midiante Azou

paite: TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Na kiang a om mite, Midiante akhut ua ka piakna ding in atam lua uh. Huchi lou in zaw Israelte'n, 'Ei khut ngei a kihunkhia i hi uh,' chi in ahon otkhum kha ding uhi.

Huaiziak in ngai in, mite zak in, 'Kuapeuh lau leh ling a-omleh kik nawn henla,' Gilead tang a pan paikik nawn hen, chi in genkhia in," achi hi. Huchi in mite singnih-le-sangnih akik nawn ua; singkhat a-om lai uhi.

TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mite atam lo lai uh. Lui ah pisuk inla, huai ah ke'n ka hon khensak ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai heh, ka chih peuhmah na kiang ah pai hen. Hiai mi zaw na kiang ah pai kei heh, ka chih peuhmah pai kei hen," achi hi.
Huchi in lui ah mite apisuk a, TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Ui bang a, alei a tui liahthoh peuhmah atuam in koih inla, huchi mah bang in kun a khukdin a tui hipthoh peuhmah leng," achi hi.
Akhutpek a liahthohte mi zathum ahi ua, midang tengteng kun a khukdin a tui hip vek ahi uh.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Gideon kiang ah, "Mi zathum, aliah a liahthohte zang in ka hon hunkhe ding. Midiante na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi. Mipi teng amau mun chiat ah pai nawn uhen," achi hi.
Huchi in mite'n nek ding leh apengkulte uh atawi ua; Israel mi tengteng apuanin lam uah apaisak vek a, mi zathumte ahihleh a-omsak a, Midiante kulh bel anuai phaizang a om ahi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai zan in TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Thou inla, kulh ah va hohsuk dih ve; na khut ah ka hon peta.
Himahleh hohsuk na lauhleh na sikha Purah toh kulh ah va hohsuk phot un.
Huchi in athugen uh na za dia; huai khit chiang in na khut hihhat in a-om dia, kulh ah na hoh ngamta ding,” achi hi. Huchi in asikha Purah toh kulh a galvengte tuah masakna pen omna ah ahohsuk uhi.
Midiante, Amalekte leh suahlam tapate tengteng huai phaizang ah khaupehon bang in tampi ana om ua; asangawngsaute uh sim seng vual louh, atamlam uh lah tuipi piau a piaunel zah mahmah ahi uhi.

Gideon atunsuk in, ngai in, mi khat in alawmpa amang ana hilh a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, mang ka nei a, Midiante kulh ah barli buh tanghou phel ana om a, puanin ah ana tuklut a, ahon hihchim a, ahih lumlet a, puanin akiphah maimah," achi hi.
Alawmpa'n adawng a, "Huai ahihleh Israel mi, Joash tapa Gideon namsau lou bangdang hi kei e. Pathian in Midiante leh sepaih tengteng akhut a pia ahita ve," achi hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon in huai mang leh alehkhiakna akihilhchian uh azak in Pathian abeta hi. Huchi in Israelte kulh lam ah akik nawn a, "Thou dih uh; TOUPA'N Midian sepaihte na khut uah ahon peta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in mi zathumte pawl thum in akhen a, avek un pengkul leh leibel vuak, asung a meisel koihsa ape chiat hi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon en unla, ka hih bang in hih sam un. Ngai un, kulh tuah masakpen ka tun chiang a ka hih bang a na hih sam ding uh ahi.
Kei leh ka kiang a om tengteng in pengkul ka hon mut chiang un, kulh kimvel a om tengteng in pengkul na mut sam ding uhi, "TOUPA a ding leh Gideon a ding in' na chi chiat ding uh," achi hi.
Huchi in Gideon leh akiang a om mi zakhatte zanven laizang, galven akikhen kuan laitak in kulh tuah masak atungsuk ua, pengkul amut ua, aleibel tawi uh atatkham uhi.
Pawl thumte'n pengkul amut ua, leibelte atatkham ua, akhut veilam un meisel atawi ua, ataklam un pengkul mut ding atawi uhi. "TOUPA leh Gideon namsau," chi in akikou uhi.
Kulh kim ah michih amau panmun chiat ah adingh vek ua; huchi in sepaih tengteng atai ua; akikou ua, ataizak uhi.
Mi zathumte'n pengkulte amut ua, TOUPA'N sepaih tengteng amau leh amau namsau in akisualsak a, huchi in sepaihte Zererah a Beth-shittah, Tabbath kiang a Abel-meholah gamgi pha in ataizak uhi.
Israelte Naphtali, Asher leh Manasseh tengteng a pan kigawmkhawm in Midiante anung-delhta uhi.

Gideon in Ephraim tanggam tengteng ah, Midiante hong sual un, Beth-barah tan in luite na lakkhalh un, Jordan lui toh, chi in mite avialtaisak a, huchi in Ephraim tengteng akikhawm ua, Beth-barah tan in luite Jordan lui toh ana lakkhalh vek uhi.

Midian kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb aman ua; Oreb suangpi ah athat ua, Zeeb pen Zeeb grep sukna khuk ah athat uhi. Midiante adelhta ua, huchi in Oreb leh Zeeb lutang Jordan lui gal a Gideon kiang ah ahon tun uhi.
